command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
BASE=/var/lib/file-integrity
CHECKSCRIPT=/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh

echo "=== STEP 1: prep baseline directory ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p "$BASE"
sudo -n chmod 700 "$BASE"

echo "=== STEP 2: build file list (files + symlinks) under /etc ==="
sudo -n sh -c "find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l \) | sort > $BASE/etc-filelist.txt"

echo "=== STEP 3: hash all regular files (sha256) ==="
sudo -n sh -c "find /etc -xdev -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > $BASE/etc-baseline.sha256"

echo "=== STEP 4: capture metadata (type|mode|uid|gid|size|mtime|path|symlink-target) ==="
sudo -n sh -c "find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type d -o -type l \) -printf '%y|%m|%U|%G|%s|%T@|%p|%l\n' | sort > $BASE/etc-metadata.txt"

echo "=== STEP 5: record baseline creation time and node identity ==="
sudo -n sh -c "date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > $BASE/baseline-created-utc.txt"
sudo -n sh -c "uname -a > $BASE/baseline-node-info.txt"

echo "=== STEP 6: self-hash the baseline artifacts (tamper-evidence for the manifest itself) ==="
sudo -n sh -c "cd $BASE && sha256sum etc-filelist.txt etc-baseline.sha256 etc-metadata.txt baseline-created-utc.txt baseline-node-info.txt > manifest.sha256"

echo "=== STEP 7: lock down permissions on baseline dir (root-only) ==="
sudo -n chown -R root:root "$BASE"
sudo -n chmod 600 "$BASE"/*.txt "$BASE"/*.sha256
sudo -n chmod 700 "$BASE"
ls -la "$BASE"

echo "=== STEP 8: install reusable check script ==="
cat <<'SCRIPT' | sudo -n tee "$CHECKSCRIPT" >/dev/null
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
BASE=/var/lib/file-integrity
STATUS=0

echo "== /etc integrity check against baseline ($(cat "$BASE/baseline-created-utc.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)) =="

echo "--- Hash/content verification (modified or missing files) ---"
if ! sha256sum -c "$BASE/etc-baseline.sha256" --quiet 2>/tmp/etc-integrity-hash-errors.txt; then
    STATUS=1
fi
cat /tmp/etc-integrity-hash-errors.txt 2>/dev/null || true

echo "--- New/removed files or symlinks ---"
find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type l \) | sort > /tmp/etc-filelist-now.txt
if ! diff -u "$BASE/etc-filelist.txt" /tmp/etc-filelist-now.txt; then
    STATUS=1
fi

echo "--- Metadata changes (permissions/ownership/size/mtime) ---"
find /etc -xdev \( -type f -o -type d -o -type l \) -printf '%y|%m|%U|%G|%s|%T@|%p|%l\n' | sort > /tmp/etc-metadata-now.txt
if ! diff -u "$BASE/etc-metadata.txt" /tmp/etc-metadata-now.txt; then
    STATUS=1
fi

if [ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "RESULT: CLEAN - no changes detected in /etc since baseline"
else
    echo "RESULT: CHANGES DETECTED in /etc since baseline"
fi
exit "$STATUS"
SCRIPT
sudo -n chmod 700 "$CHECKSCRIPT"
sudo -n chown root:root "$CHECKSCRIPT"

echo "=== STEP 9: run initial check to prove baseline is self-consistent (expect CLEAN) ==="
sudo -n "$CHECKSCRIPT"
echo "CHECK_EXIT=$?"

echo "=== STEP 10: summary counts ==="
echo "files hashed: $(sudo -n wc -l < $BASE/etc-baseline.sha256)"
echo "filelist entries: $(sudo -n wc -l < $BASE/etc-filelist.txt)"
echo "metadata entries: $(sudo -n wc -l < $BASE/etc-metadata.txt)"

echo "=== DONE ==="
